intro.sr: Klijent sam pregleda i otkazuje svoj budući termin iz naloga, bez poziva ili poruke salonu: meni naloga, „Moji termini“, termin iz liste, „Otkaži termin“.
intro.en: A customer views and cancels their own upcoming appointment from their account, without calling or messaging the salon: account menu, “Moji termini”, the appointment from the list, “Otkaži termin”.

pregled-termina.sr: U „Moji termini“ vidimo listu zakazanih termina.
pregled-termina.en: “Moji termini” shows the list of booked appointments.

otvaranje-detalja-termina.sr: {Kliknemo} termin u listi. Dugme za otkazivanje je vidljivo jer je termin dovoljno daleko u budućnosti.
otvaranje-detalja-termina.en: We {click} the appointment in the list. The cancel button is visible because the appointment is far enough in the future.

otkazivanje-termina.sr: {Kliknemo} „Otkaži termin“, potvrđujemo u prozoru i termin je otkazan.
otkazivanje-termina.en: We {click} “Otkaži termin”, confirm in the dialog and the appointment is cancelled.
